description: WRITE. Create or update YOUR man-hours (工数) for one date (YYYY-MM-DD, Japan time): minutes per project task. Only the tasks you list are overwritten; other tasks that day are kept. Removing an entry is delete_manhours, not a zero. Confirm the project, task, and minutes with the user before calling. Idempotent for the same entries. Refuses a day that is closed (締め) or fixed (確定) — do not retry; it must be reopened in the web UI. Find IDs with get_my_projects (prefer it over list_projects) and list_tasks. close_out tells you which dates are missing. If this tool is not listed, the server is read-only (KINTAI_PLUS_READ_ONLY).

confirm.description: Set true to apply this write when the client cannot show a confirmation dialog. If confirmation is required and this is omitted, the tool returns a preview and changes nothing. Ignored when this call does not require confirmation.

date.description: Date to save (YYYY-MM-DD, Japan time). Required. No default.

minutes.description: Minutes worked on this task (e.g. 90 = 1.5 hours).

taskId.description: From list_tasks for that projectId. Must belong to the project.

name: save_manhours
title: Save my man-hours
